FEAT-1-STORY-043.title: Define provider search request/response schema contract
FEAT-1-STORY-043.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty) and structured outputs (provider list, scores, metadata) to ensure consistent contract across facade, service, and API layers.

FEAT-1-STORY-044.title: Implement specialty identification integration for search queries
FEAT-1-STORY-044.description: Integrate specialty_service into provider search flow to expand and normalize user queries into NUCC taxonomy codes using regex + vector pipeline before executing search.

FEAT-1-STORY-045.title: Integrate find_care_facade orchestration for provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-045.description: Ensure find_care_facade orchestrates provider_search_service, specialty_service, and input validation, returning normalized results to tool_router with proper error handling and fallback sequencing.

FEAT-1-STORY-046.title: Enable tool_router dispatch for provider search tool
FEAT-1-STORY-046.description: Configure tool_router to allowlist and correctly dispatch provider search requests, including validation, tool selection, and integration with the conversational agent tool-use loop.

FEAT-1-STORY-047.title: Add logging and debug instrumentation for provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-047.description: Instrument provider search flow with debug_logger to capture query inputs, embedding usage, fallback triggers, and performance metrics for observability and troubleshooting.
